text: <@U07MWC5T8FJ> sorry I missed your message during R Dev Day @ useR! - as they had a conference Slack we were using that instead. For future reference I usually put all the useful links in a post in GitHub Discussions on the R Dev Day repo, <https://github.com/r-devel/r-dev-day/discussions|github.com/r-devel/r-dev-day/discussions>, so that's the place to look. I email participants via Pretix as far as possible, so it's important to get a ticket there even if you're just attending virtually. For events with open registration (vs events with participants selected by application), you can find all the ticket pages at <https://pretix.eu/r-contributors/|pretix.eu/r-contributors>.
